extraction_notes: This is a MetLife "Basic Term Life / AD&D" GCERT Life Benefit Summary - a simple 1-3 page flat-benefit summary, NOT an age-banded rate table document. Layout: Page 1 has a single summary table with rows: Basic Life (flat dollar amount, e.g. $50,000), Accidental Death & Dismemberment (usually stated as 'equal to Basic Life Insurance' i.e. AD&D included at same amount), Plan Maximum, Non-Medical Maximum, Age Reduction Formula (e.g. '35% at Age 65, 50% at Age 70'), and Employee Contribution percentages for Basic Life and AD&D (typically both 0% since employer-paid). There is only ONE coverage class in this document type: 'Employee' (no Spouse/Child/Dependent classes are shown for this basic employer-paid plan). Record it as rate_structure='flat' with flat_amount = the Basic Life dollar amount and flat_rate = 0 if contribution is 0% (this is a fully employer-paid flat benefit, not a per-$1000 rate table). AD&D should be marked add_included=true since it equals the life amount, not a separate product/table. Pages 2-3 are boilerplate legal/exclusions text and footnotes (features 1-9) - no additional rate data there. Total count for this doc: 1 product ('Basic Term Life / AD&D'), 1 coverage class ('Employee'). If a future MetLife doc includes Supplemental/Voluntary Life with actual age-banded per-$1000 rate tables (e.g. columns like Under 30, 30-34, etc. by coverage amount), extract those separately using rate_structure='age_banded' with age_bands array - this basic doc simply doesn't have that structure. Also watch for possible additional classes (Spouse/Child) in supplemental versions of this carrier's docs - none present here.
